name: Deep Purple

whyMatters.en: Began as Roundabout in 1967–68, then Deep Purple. Mark II (Blackmore / Gillan / Glover / Lord / Paice) set Hammond organ equal to guitar on In Rock and Machine Head; Blackmore left in 1975 to form Rainbow, later rejoining the Mk II reunion.
whyMatters.zh: 1967–68 年由 Roundabout 起步，后称 Deep Purple。Mark II（Blackmore / Gillan / Glover / Lord / Paice）在《In Rock》《Machine Head》上确立 Hammond 与吉他对等；Blackmore 1975 离队组建 Rainbow，后又参与 Mk II 重聚。

note.en: Joe South cover; US Top 5 single that pushed Shades of Deep Purple onto the Billboard chart.
note.zh: 翻唱 Joe South；美榜前 5 单曲，带动《Shades of Deep Purple》上榜。

note.en: Open-fifth riff from Machine Head; lyric about the Montreux casino fire. First US gold album for the band.
note.zh: 出自《Machine Head》的开放五度 riff；歌词写蒙特勒赌场火灾。乐队首张美国金唱片。

note.en: UK #1 single from Machine Head; Blackmore classical figures trade with Lord’s Hammond.
note.zh: 《Machine Head》英榜冠军单曲；Blackmore 古典音型与 Lord Hammond 交替。

note.en: From Deep Purple in Rock (UK Top 5). Gillan scream over Lord’s organ bed; Blackmore-led hard-rock turn after Concerto for Group and Orchestra.
note.zh: 出自《Deep Purple in Rock》（英榜前 5）。Gillan 尖叫压在 Lord 管风琴铺底上；《Concerto for Group and Orchestra》之后由 Blackmore 主导的硬摇滚转向。

shortBio.en: Mark II hard rock; Smoke on the Water made the open-fifth riff a worldwide beginner standard. Blackmore exits to Rainbow; Gillan and Hughes later pass through Black Sabbath.
shortBio.zh: Mark II hard rock；《Smoke on the Water》的开放五度 riff 成为全球入门标准之一。Blackmore 离队组建 Rainbow；Gillan 与 Hughes 后来都进过 Black Sabbath。

body.en:
Chris Curtis recruited Ritchie Blackmore and Jon Lord into Roundabout (1967). By April 1968 Curtis was out; Ian Paice, Nick Simper, and Rod Evans joined, and the band became Deep Purple. Shades of Deep Purple (1968) reached US #24 on the strength of Hush (Joe South cover, US Top 5). Gillan and Glover from Episode Six replaced Evans and Simper for a harder sound after Concerto for Group and Orchestra (1969).

Deep Purple in Rock (1970), Fireball (1971), and Machine Head (1972)—with Smoke on the Water and Highway Star—plus Made in Japan (1972) define Mark II. Who Do We Think We Are (1973) made them the top-earning US band that year; Gillan and Glover then left, replaced by David Coverdale and Glenn Hughes. Blackmore quit in 1975 for Rainbow; Tommy Bolin filled guitar on Come Taste the Band before the mid-1970s split and Bolin’s death. Coverdale, Lord, and Paice moved toward Whitesnake; Gillan later sang on Black Sabbath’s Born Again. The Mark II reunion Perfect Strangers (1984) went platinum. Later seats include Joe Lynn Turner (ex-Rainbow), Steve Morse, and Don Airey (ex-Rainbow / Whitesnake) after Lord’s 2002 exit.
body.zh:
Chris Curtis 于 1967 年招入 Ritchie Blackmore 与 Jon Lord 组建 Roundabout。1968 年 4 月 Curtis 出局，Ian Paice、Nick Simper、Rod Evans 加入，乐队改名 Deep Purple。《Shades of Deep Purple》（1968）凭翻唱 Joe South 的《Hush》（美榜前 5）升至美榜第 24。Episode Six 的 Gillan、Glover 取代 Evans、Simper；《Concerto for Group and Orchestra》（1969）之后转向更硬的音色。

《Deep Purple in Rock》（1970）、《Fireball》（1971）、《Machine Head》（1972）——含《Smoke on the Water》《Highway Star》——以及现场《Made in Japan》（1972）界定 Mark II。《Who Do We Think We Are》（1973）使乐队成为当年美国收入最高乐队；随后 Gillan、Glover 离队，由 David Coverdale、Glenn Hughes 接替。Blackmore 1975 离队组建 Rainbow；Tommy Bolin 在《Come Taste the Band》顶吉他，乐队于 1970 年代中期解散，Bolin 不久因吸毒去世。Coverdale、Lord、Paice 转向 Whitesnake；Gillan 后来主唱 Black Sabbath《Born Again》。Mark II 重聚专辑《Perfect Strangers》（1984）白金。之后主唱含前 Rainbow 的 Joe Lynn Turner；Lord 2002 单飞后键盘为前 Rainbow / Whitesnake 的 Don Airey，吉他为 Steve Morse。

title.zh: 管风琴与 riff 并列

body.en:
Mark II sets hard rock with Lord’s Hammond equal to Blackmore’s guitar in the live mix—more organ-forward than Led Zeppelin or Black Sabbath.

Machine Head (1972) and Made in Japan are the main studio and live documents. Metallica, Def Leppard, and Dream Theater have cited the live album; Dream Theater covered its full set in 2006.

Unlike peers who dropped singles, Purple kept Black Night and Strange Kind of Woman as UK Top 10 singles.
body.zh:
Mark II 确立 hard rock 中 Lord 的 Hammond 与 Blackmore 吉他在现场混音中对等——管风琴比重高于 Led Zeppelin 或 Black Sabbath。

《Machine Head》（1972）与《Made in Japan》是主要录音室与现场文献。Metallica、Def Leppard、Dream Theater 都提过这张现场专；Dream Theater 2006 年现场翻唱全碟。

与放弃单曲路线的同辈不同，Purple 仍有《Black Night》《Strange Kind of Woman》等英榜前 10 单曲。

title.en: Mark I / II / III and Rainbow exit
title.zh: Mark I / II / III 与 Rainbow 离队

body.en:
Mark I: Evans/Simper psychedelic–hard mix and Hush. Mark II: Gillan/Glover peak—In Rock through Made in Japan. Mark III: Coverdale/Hughes on Burn and Stormbringer.

Blackmore exits mid-1975 to form Rainbow after disputes over musical direction. Ian Paice remains the continuous drum seat across marks.

Gillan later joins Black Sabbath for Born Again; Hughes sings on Sabbath’s Seventh Star—shared Purple↔Sabbath thread.
body.zh:
Mark I：Evans/Simper 迷幻—硬摇滚混合与《Hush》。Mark II：Gillan/Glover 峰值——《In Rock》至《Made in Japan》。Mark III：Coverdale/Hughes 的《Burn》《Stormbringer》。

Blackmore 因音乐方向争执于 1975 年中离队组建 Rainbow。Ian Paice 是各 Mark 中连续的鼓席。

Gillan 后来主唱 Black Sabbath《Born Again》；Hughes 唱 Sabbath《Seventh Star》——Purple↔Sabbath 人员交叉。

alt.en: Ritchie Blackmore with Deep Purple, Hannover, 1 December 1970
alt.zh: Ritchie Blackmore 与 Deep Purple，汉诺威，1970 年 12 月 1 日

body.en:
Open-fifth figure over Lord’s organ and Paice’s pocket. The lyric documents the Montreux casino fire during the Machine Head sessions.

It became one of the first riffs many guitarists learn worldwide. Highway Star on the same album shows the speed and neoclassical lead side.
body.zh:
开放五度音型压在 Lord 管风琴与 Paice 律动上。歌词记录《Machine Head》录音期间蒙特勒赌场火灾。

成为全球许多吉他手最早学会的 riff 之一。同一专辑的《Highway Star》展示速度与新古典主音面。

body.en:
1984 Mark II reunion: Paice, Lord, Blackmore, Glover, Gillan—Perfect Strangers goes platinum. The House of Blue Light (1987) sits between styles; Gillan and Blackmore clash again.

Slaves and Masters (1990) uses Joe Lynn Turner (ex-Rainbow) on vocals. Gillan returns for The Battle Rages On… (1993); Blackmore exits before Purpendicular (1996). Joe Satriani tours, then Steve Morse records Abandon (1998). Don Airey (ex-Rainbow) replaces Lord in 2002.
body.zh:
1984 年 Mark II 重聚：Paice、Lord、Blackmore、Glover、Gillan——《Perfect Strangers》白金。《The House of Blue Light》（1987）处于风格转换期；Gillan 与 Blackmore 再起冲突。

《Slaves and Masters》（1990）主唱为前 Rainbow 的 Joe Lynn Turner。Gillan 回归录制《The Battle Rages On…》（1993）；Blackmore 在《Purpendicular》（1996）前离队。Joe Satriani 巡演顶替，Steve Morse 参与《Abandon》（1998）。2002 年 Lord 单飞后，前 Rainbow 的 Don Airey 接键盘。

alt.en: Ian Gillan with Deep Purple, Hannover, 1 December 1970
alt.zh: Ian Gillan 与 Deep Purple，汉诺威，1970 年 12 月 1 日

body.en:
Iron Maiden and later metal acts cite the riff-plus-organ weight and Gillan-range vocals. Rainbow continues Blackmore’s neoclassical lead path with Dio, then Bonnet and Turner.

Gillan and Hughes’ Sabbath years keep Purple tied to that Birmingham catalog. Smoke on the Water remains a common first riff for guitar students.
body.zh:
Iron Maiden 与后来金属引用「riff + 管风琴」的重量与 Gillan 音域人声。Rainbow 以 Dio，再到 Bonnet、Turner，延续 Blackmore 的新古典主音路径。

Gillan 与 Hughes 的 Sabbath 时期把 Purple 与那条伯明翰曲目线相连。《Smoke on the Water》仍是吉他入门常学的 riff。

note.en: Roundabout → Deep Purple. Hush / Shades era before Gillan/Glover.
note.zh: Roundabout → Deep Purple。Gillan/Glover 前的《Hush》/《Shades》时期。

note.en: In Rock / Machine Head / Made in Japan; Perfect Strangers reunion.
note.zh: 《In Rock》/《Machine Head》/《Made in Japan》；《Perfect Strangers》重聚。

note.en: Burn / Stormbringer; Blackmore exits 1975 to Rainbow.
Joe Lynn Turner from Rainbow on vocals after Gillan exits again.
note.zh: Gillan 再次离队后，前 Rainbow 主唱 Joe Lynn Turner 接任。

note.en: Open-fifth riff; among the most widely learned guitar figures.
note.zh: 开放五度 riff；全球最常学的吉他音型之一。

note.en: Hammond equal to guitar in the hard-rock mix; Blackmore’s Rainbow exit and Gillan/Hughes Sabbath years cross-link the catalogs.
note.zh: Hard-rock 混音中 Hammond 与吉他对等；Blackmore 组建 Rainbow，以及 Gillan/Hughes 的 Sabbath 时期，使曲目线交叉。
